built_from: WordNet 3.0 (NLTK); ImageNet-1k synsets; up 2 levels, down to cousins
excluded: ImageNet classes, all their WordNet ancestors and descendants, names equal to any ImageNet lemma

pool.name: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World

relations: relation of each name to its nearest ImageNet class (by Wu-Palmer): sibling, parent's sibling, sibling's child, cousin, cousin's child, grandparent's sibling, distant
clusters: cluster = lowest common WordNet ancestor with the nearest ImageNet class (648 clusters)
